description: The University of Calgary compiles published permafrost thaw-settlement tests into linked CSV tables. The deposit lists five CSV files and a README, despite its introductory statement referring to four data files. Individual loading steps contain applied vertical stress in kPa, cumulative deformation in millimetres, strain and void ratio. Companion tables describe sample depths, grain-size distributions, borehole locations, original sources and derived thaw-strain parameters, with quality flags from low to high. Zenodo version 1.2.1 is free under CC-BY-4.0. The data can calibrate settlement and foundation-performance simulations and compare empirical thaw-strain predictions for roads, buildings and pipelines. Sample identifiers connect measurements to their material properties and source evidence. Coverage consists of source-specific test sites; the complete geographic extent and test dates remain unknown from the inspected metadata. Coordinates are assumed WGS84 and some historical positions are rounded. These measurements complement the companion R processing code and require local ground investigation before site-specific design.
